initiate_order.description: Start choosing items for a new basket; not checkout. Explicit item additions use add_to_basket.

add_to_basket.description: Request new items for the basket, including additions with missing choices. Answers to a pending choice use customize_confirmation.

update_order.description: Change items, flavor, size, or quantity in an unplaced basket. Pending choice answers use customize_confirmation. Changes to an already placed order use order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation.

delete_entry.description: Remove an item or reduce its quantity in an unplaced basket, including answers identifying the item to remove.

check_order_cart.description: Ask to view the current basket, its total, summary or changed prices; not consent to checkout.

reorder_or_repeat.description: Ask to repeat a past order; not an explicit addition of named menu items.

order_scheduling.description: Ask to schedule this order for later. Store referral only, including during checkout; no scheduling action or slot collection.

order_channels_and_modes.description: Ask about ordering channels, fulfillment modes, delivery fees or minimums; also select a fulfillment preference before checkout.

special_requests.description: Request a non-catalog customization or special arrangement, including a new item conditional on it. Store referral only; no basket action or detail collection. Standard catalog choices stay add/update requests.

how_to_order.description: Ask how to order; not a command to add items or begin checkout.

insufficient_information_order.description: An ordering request whose intended operation is unclear. A known add, edit, removal or checkout keeps its specific route even when details are missing.

order_payment.description: Ask about payment or retrieve, resend or retry payment for an existing order. Starting checkout or supplying an open checkout field uses order_confirmation.

customize_confirmation.description: Supply a requested item, flavor, size or quantity for a pending basket choice. Continue that request; not a new addition. Removal target answers use delete_entry.

payment_confirmation.description: Report having paid or ask whether payment succeeded. The claim is not proof; payment must be verified by the handler.

order_confirmation.description: Start or resume checkout, finish ordering, answer an open checkout field, or confirm the quoted order. Address confirmation alone is not checkout consent.

cancel_and_abort.description: Legacy label; use general/cancel_and_abort for stopping pending work. Placed-order cancellations use order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation.

order_status_tracking.description: Ask for the status or tracking of an existing order or delivery; a read-only enquiry.

missing_or_wrong_items.description: Report wrong, missing, damaged or melted items, or request a replacement. Store referral; explicit refunds or placed-order changes use refund_and_cancellation.

refund_and_cancellation.description: Request a refund, cancel a placed order or change its items or quantities, including within a complaint. Store referral; no verified order or receipt is required.

address_or_contact_update.description: Request an address/contact change for a placed order or ask staff to call a supplied contact. Store referral; no contact update or callback is performed.

delivery_problems.description: Report a late, failed or disputed delivery, or trouble contacting its driver. Store referral without collecting investigation details.

general_order_enquiry.description: General order, delivery or logistics support without a more specific enquiry topic.

get_order_history.description: Ask to view or summarize past orders; a read-only enquiry, not a request to reorder.

availability.description: Ask which menu items or flavors are offered or available; not a request to add them.

recommendations.description: Ask for a recommendation, popular item or help choosing what to try.

dietary_preferences.description: Ask about dietary suitability or options such as vegan, eggless, dairy-free or sugar-free. Explicit allergy questions use allergens.

allergens.description: Ask about allergens, allergy safety or cross-contact; takes precedence over general dietary preferences.

ingredients.description: Ask what an item contains or about its recipe or composition.

nutrition.description: Ask about calories, nutrients or nutritional information; dietary labels use dietary_preferences.

preparation.description: Ask how a menu item is made or prepared.

pricing.description: Ask an item or size price, including a corrected item name after a price question. Mentioning quantity does not request a basket change.

specialty_items.description: Ask about signature, premium or specialty menu items.

explore_options.description: Ask to browse the menu, categories or available choices.

pairings.description: Ask which items or flavors go well together.

source_quality.description: Ask about ingredient sourcing, freshness or quality.

flavor_profile.description: Ask how an item tastes, including texture or sweetness.

portion_and_size.description: Ask about serving sizes, package contents, volume or weight; not choosing a size for a pending addition.

choose_delivery_address.description: Choose a saved address for delivery. Not confirmation of an already selected address or setting a default for future orders.

add_delivery_address.description: Supply or save a new typed delivery address, including partial address-field replies. Before checkout this is address management; an address requested by open checkout stays order_confirmation.

update_delivery_address.description: Correct or update a saved delivery address; not the address on a placed order.

existing_addresses.description: Ask to list or read saved delivery addresses without selecting or changing one.

delete_delivery_address.description: Ask to delete a saved delivery address. The handler directs the user to the app; this is not delivery selection.

set_default_delivery_address.description: Set a saved address as the default for future orders; not selecting an address for the current delivery.

verify_address_for_delivery.description: Ask whether delivery covers an area, address or pincode. Published delivery fees and minimums use placing_order/order_channels_and_modes.

confirm_delivery_address.description: Confirm the address in an open address-confirmation question, including after an information detour. Not checkout confirmation or a new address.

deny_delivery_address.description: Reject the address in an open address-confirmation question; not cancellation of the order.

location_and_hours.description: Ask for the cafe address, directions, map link or opening hours.

brand_story.description: Ask about the origin, history or story of the cafe or brand.

amenities.description: Ask about facilities or amenities such as seating, parking or Wi-Fi.

events_and_tours.description: Ask about cafe events, factory visits or tours.

team_and_policy.description: Ask about the team, founders, ownership, legal entity or company policies.

about_the_brand.description: Ask general questions about the company, brand, reviews or reputation, including Google ratings.

out_of_scope.description: A meaningful request unrelated to the cafe or its services; not a cafe question with missing facts.

insufficient_information.description: The intended request is unclear and needs clarification. Missing execution details or unavailable facts alone do not make a known intent unclear.

greeting.description: A standalone greeting or opening salutation.

goodbye.description: A farewell or conversation ending; not cancellation of pending work.

thanks.description: An expression of gratitude; not consent to repeat an action.

small_talk.description: Casual social conversation without a substantive cafe request.

cancel_and_abort.description: Stop the current conversation task, not a placed order. An explicit placed-order cancellation uses order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation. If a bare cancel could mean either the pending task or a placed order, this control lets the workflow clarify the target.

wait.description: Ask to pause existing work while keeping it pending. Not cancellation, scheduling for later or a new addition with a deferred choice.
